sections.title_hint: The {Framework} Breakdown: Business Quality, Scored and Decomposed
required: standalone scoring section: framework, composite, every dimension defended
delta from prior score with exact reconciliation arithmetic
band placement and cohort table
state the falsifier per dimension

sections.title_hint: Executive Summary: {The House That X Built}
required: the whole thesis in two pages
the one paradox or tension the report resolves
quality-adjusted price expression (per-point ladder; correlation stays embargoed)
origin, architecture of the business, what it actually sells
the category it created or occupies

sections.title_hint: The Bricks: Products and Services, Layer by Layer
required: every product line with revenue where disclosed, sourced
which layers are growing and which carry the future

sections.title_hint: The Mortar: How the Money Is Made
required: pricing mechanics in detail
unit economics: what a dollar of usage costs and earns

sections.title_hint: The Builders: Customers and What They Do
required: customer counts, concentration, retention, all dated
two or three named use cases from disclosures
each competitive front with the honest score
where the company loses today

sections.title_hint: The Blueprint: Strategy, Read Through Actions
required: strategy inferred from acquisitions, partnerships, capital, not from slogans
run-rate ladder with every dated print
margin trajectory against any gate or floor
capital structure: equity vs debt, with the equity-only CE ruling applied

sections.title_hint: The Appraisal: What the Business Is Worth
required: valuation ladder of completed marks only; rumored rounds analyzed, never adopted
comparables with growth adjustment
scenario band with the arithmetic shown

sections.title_hint: The Stress Test: What Would Change the Answer
required: the bear case argued honestly at full strength
named, dated falsifiers per pillar
the position, plainly
the watch list with dates
the single falsifier
full categorized fact sheet with source, date, tier on every row
